review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines one new object, `powerImage_quotientMap`, which is the continuous bundling of `QuotientGroup.map` for the identity map between power-image quotients. I searched Mathlib's `Topology/Algebra` for a ready-made continuous quotient-map construction (`QuotientGroup.map` as a `→ₜ*`). I found nothing equivalent. The only hit was `PontryaginDual.map`, which is unrelated. I also searched the Formal Frontier libraries for a competing transition-map definition and found none. The only uses are the tests and `ProcyclicResidueLimit`, which both use this definition. The other declarations are theorems about this map, and the rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication. The `ZMod` comparison uses Mathlib's `ZMod.castHom` directly. I found no competing definition and no clear cost from consolidating, so I abstain. I did not inspect `ProcyclicPowerIndex`'s `powerImage` definition in depth.
